title: 基礎生物学Ⅰ
subtitle: Basic Biology I
teachers:
HIRATA Hiroaki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will learn:
(1) roles of various substances common to all organisms,
(2) the mechanism of metabolism,
(3) the mechanism of gene expression and cell division,
(4) types of immunity, and
(5) biodiversity and environmental degradation in ecosystems.
advice:
Together with Basic Biology 2, this course provides basic knowledge of biology.

We will cover the following materials:
1. Biomolecules and the chemistry of life,
2. Energy, enzymes, and metabolism,
3. Control of gene expression,
4. The process of cell division,
5. Types and mechanism of immunity, and
6. Biodiversity and the interconnectedness of life.

Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.
Students are expected to work together in groups to complete tasks in class.
Students should pay attention to the teacher’s instructions in the class since the schedule for quizzes, tests and reports may change depending on progress of classes.
Students should attend all classes; otherwise, the handouts may not be received.
Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before each class.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully understand structures/functions of proteins and their industrial uses.
(2) Fully understand pathways of catabolism and anabolism.
(3) Fully understand the detailed process of gene expression.
(4) Fully understand the detailed mechanism of immunity.
(5) Fully understand interactions among species in ecosystems and present own opinions on them.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Explain structures/functions of proteins.
(2) Explain catabolism and anabolism.
(3) Explain the outline of gene expression.
(4) Explain types of immunity.
(5) Explain interactions among species in ecosystems.
(6) Report on literature research.
